m: पि-हित mfn. shut, hidden, concealed, covered or filled with (instr.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
पि-हित n. a partic. figure of speech which consists in insinuating to a person that one knows his secrets, Kuval.
a: पिहित — p. p. 1 Shut, closed, barred. --2 Covered, concealed, hidden. --3 Filled or covered with; see अपिहित also. --तं A figure of speech which consists in insinuating to a person that one knows his secrets.

m: पिहुलि m. N. of a serpent-demon, L.
